preconditions.description: The number of points n must be between 2 and 2000 inclusive.
The maximum allowed running time k must be between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'no solution' or (len(points) == n and all(len(point) == 2 for point in points) and all(-10**9 <= point[0] <= 10**9 for point in points) and all(-10**9 <= point[1] <= 10**9 for point in points) and len(set(tuple(point) for point in points)) == n and tot > k)
postconditions.description: The output must either be 'no solution' or a list of n distinct points with coordinates within the range [-10^9, 10^9] such that the running time tot of the given code exceeds k.
